name: What are common signs that my window trim needs repair?

mainEntity.name: What are common signs that my window trim needs repair?

acceptedAnswer.text: Common signs that your window trim needs repair include visible rot, cracks, peeling paint, or gaps where the trim meets the siding or window frame. These issues can allow moisture to penetrate, potentially leading to further damage to your home's structure. Regular inspection, especially after harsh weather, can help identify problems early. Considering factors like direct sun exposure or sprinkler proximity can highlight areas prone to needing attention sooner.
acceptedAnswer.description: Look for visible rot, cracks, peeling paint, or gaps in your window trim to determine if it needs repair.
